Ensemble of Hope#736.src: I need to get back to finding tonight's food supplies. Maybe you can go be useful elsewhere?
Ensemble of Hope#736.dst: Preciso voltar a procurar a comida desta noite. Talvez você possa ser útil em outro lugar?
Ensemble of Hope#736.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#737.src: ... You could try telling Master Azael you're alive. He'll be in the command station in the bank.
Ensemble of Hope#737.dst: ... Você podia avisar o mestre Azael que está vivo. Ele deve estar no posto de comando no banco.
Ensemble of Hope#737.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#738.src: Y'know, it's nice to finally get a break from guarding for a bit! I've been at it for hours...
Ensemble of Hope#738.dst: Sabe, é bom finalmente dar uma pausa na guarda! Estou nisso há horas...
Ensemble of Hope#738.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#739.src: Sigh... it's nearly time for the next unit rotation. Talk to you later.
Ensemble of Hope#739.dst: Ai... está quase na hora do próximo revezamento. Falo com você depois.
Ensemble of Hope#739.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#740.dst: Caixas de armas... ok. Água... ok.
Ensemble of Hope#740.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#741.src: Talk to the leaders in the bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#741.dst: Fale com os líderes no banco em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#743.src: Not yet, I am afraid. The festival will be starting within an hour or so, though...
Ensemble of Hope#743.dst: Ainda não, receio. Mas o festival deve começar dentro de uma hora, mais ou menos...
Ensemble of Hope#743.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#745.src: Ah, how wonderful! You have survived. That makes three of four teams now accounted for.
Ensemble of Hope#745.dst: Ah, que maravilha! Você sobreviveu. Com isso, temos notícia de três das quatro equipes.
Ensemble of Hope#745.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#746.src: Yes... it would seem the owls are struggling to get ahold of group {~}.
Ensemble of Hope#746.dst: Sim... parece que as corujas não conseguem contatar o grupo {~}.
Ensemble of Hope#746.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#747.src: We did, shortly after the attack. But since then, owls have been struggling to make contact. They should have arrived at the hotel, but...
Ensemble of Hope#747.dst: Tivemos, pouco depois do ataque. Mas, desde então, as corujas não conseguem fazer contato. Eles deviam ter chegado ao hotel, mas...
Ensemble of Hope#747.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#748.src: I'm starting to worry... I know we don't have instant communication, but even still, it's been a while...
Ensemble of Hope#748.dst: Estou começando a me preocupar... sei que não temos comunicação instantânea, mas já faz um tempo...
Ensemble of Hope#748.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#749.src: Hmm. Military activity has increased drastically ever since we took control. We know the owls are struggling to move from here to {p}.
Ensemble of Hope#749.dst: Hmm. A atividade militar aumentou muito desde que tomamos o controle. Sabemos que as corujas têm dificuldade de ir daqui até {p}.
Ensemble of Hope#749.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#750.src: It could be something, or it could very well be nothing. There is little we can do but wait.
Ensemble of Hope#750.dst: Pode ser alguma coisa, ou pode muito bem não ser nada. Pouco podemos fazer além de esperar.
Ensemble of Hope#750.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#751.src: Master Azael! Oh, ah, and others- news have arrived from the owls!
Ensemble of Hope#751.dst: Mestre Azael! Ah, hã, e os outros- chegaram notícias das corujas!
Ensemble of Hope#751.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#753.src: Bad, I fear. There's quite the commotion in {p} - the streets are crawling with soldiers, and the people of the city have been gathered on the festival grounds.
Ensemble of Hope#753.dst: Ruins, receio. Há um grande alvoroço em {p} - as ruas estão cheias de soldados, e o povo da cidade foi reunido no local do festival.
Ensemble of Hope#753.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#754.src: Ahead of schedule... do we know which Sovereigns are present?
Ensemble of Hope#754.dst: Antes do previsto... sabemos quais Soberanos estão presentes?
Ensemble of Hope#754.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#755.src: Thalas, naturally. And likely the Queen as well, given the circumstances.
Ensemble of Hope#755.dst: Thalas, naturalmente. E provavelmente a Rainha, dadas as circunstâncias.
Ensemble of Hope#755.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#756.src: Damn it... we need to get people to {p}! Our- our friends, they're-
Ensemble of Hope#756.dst: Droga... temos que mandar gente a {p}! Nossos- nossos amigos, eles-
Ensemble of Hope#756.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#757.src: Yes, we must, but I cannot afford to leave my position here... and I don't believe we can spare any of our fighters...
Ensemble of Hope#757.dst: Sim, precisamos, mas não posso deixar meu posto aqui... e não creio que possamos dispensar nenhum lutador...
Ensemble of Hope#757.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#758.src: Ah! Yes, that will do. Come, I'll show you the way out of the citadel.
Ensemble of Hope#758.dst: Ah! Sim, isso serve. Venha, vou te mostrar a saída da cidadela.
Ensemble of Hope#758.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#759.src: {u}... good luck. We- aah- we cannot afford to lose any more of our people. Get them back to us safely...
Ensemble of Hope#759.dst: {u}... boa sorte. Nós- aah- não podemos perder mais ninguém. Traga-os de volta em segurança...
Ensemble of Hope#759.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#761.src: Use this tunnel - it'll bring you near the entrance of the citadel. When you're done, use it from the other side to get back to us...
Ensemble of Hope#761.dst: Use este túnel - ele leva para perto da entrada da cidadela. Quando terminar, use-o do outro lado para voltar até nós...
Ensemble of Hope#761.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#762.src: ...though, ah, take care not to let any of the crown's soldiers follow you through? I'm not sure we can afford the stress!
Ensemble of Hope#762.dst: ...mas, ah, cuidado para nenhum soldado da Coroa seguir você, tá? Não sei se aguentaríamos o susto!
Ensemble of Hope#762.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#763.src: We're nearing the end, just got to stick the landing. Now, go get 'em!
Ensemble of Hope#763.dst: Quase no fim, só falta fechar com chave de ouro. Pra cima deles!
Ensemble of Hope#763.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#768.src: You tell them about the Corruption you've seen in Wynn. About what it does to the land and the people.
Ensemble of Hope#768.dst: Você fala da Corrupção que viu em Wynn. Do que ela faz com a terra e com as pessoas.

Ensemble of Hope#769.src: You... don't tell them why you think it's here. About the Queen. It'd be best to tell everyone at the same time.
Ensemble of Hope#769.dst: Você... não diz por que acha que ela está aqui. Nem fala da Rainha. Melhor contar a todos ao mesmo tempo.

Ensemble of Hope#770.src: You suddenly remember. Tasim told you the Queen wanted to speak to you. Maybe you could get an audience...?
Ensemble of Hope#770.dst: De repente, você lembra. Tasim disse que a Rainha queria falar com você. Talvez consiga uma audiência...?

Ensemble of Hope#771.src: You tell them about the War of the Realms. Of Light and Dark and War.
Ensemble of Hope#771.dst: Você fala da Guerra dos Reinos. Da Luz, da Escuridão e da Guerra.

Ensemble of Hope#772.src: You tell them about Corruption. About how it has affected Wynn, and how the recruits Fruma sends help keep it at bay.
Ensemble of Hope#772.dst: Você fala da Corrupção. De como ela afetou Wynn, e de como os recrutas que Fruma envia ajudam a contê-la.

Ensemble of Hope#773.src: You tell them about the Queen. About what she is, what she was. That killing her won't be as easy as-
Ensemble of Hope#773.dst: Você fala da Rainha. Do que ela é, do que foi. Que matá-la não será tão fácil quanto-

Ensemble of Hope#774.src: Everyone has dispersed into various groups... you can talk to them, or go rest right now.
Ensemble of Hope#774.dst: Todos se dispersaram em vários grupos... você pode falar com eles ou ir descansar agora.

Ensemble of Hope#775.src: You probably shouldn't interrupt their reunion.
Ensemble of Hope#775.dst: Melhor não interromper o reencontro deles.

Ensemble of Hope#777.src: It looks like everyone else has already gone out. It's just you, now.
Ensemble of Hope#777.dst: Parece que todos os outros já saíram. Agora é só você.

Ensemble of Hope#778.src: Let's hope I'm not stuck here forever...
Ensemble of Hope#778.dst: Que eu não fique preso aqui pra sempre...

Ensemble of Hope#780.src: - Provide minimum necessary food and water. If work is completed, increase ration allotments.
Ensemble of Hope#780.dst: - Fornecer o mínimo de comida e água. Se o trabalho for feito, aumentar as rações.

Ensemble of Hope#781.src: - Provide Eternal Wellspring water each year to maintain longevity.
Ensemble of Hope#781.dst: - Dar água do Eternal Wellspring a cada ano para a longevidade.

Ensemble of Hope#782.src: - No sources of entertainment are permitted beyond assigned projects.
Ensemble of Hope#782.dst: - Proibida qualquer diversão além dos projetos designados.

Ensemble of Hope#783.src: - Under NO circumstances must the curse-proof gate be opened. High escape risk.
Ensemble of Hope#783.dst: - Em NENHUMA hipótese abrir o portão antimaldição. Alto risco de fuga.

Ensemble of Hope#784.src: Speak to Two in the palace's throne room. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#784.dst: Fale com Two na sala do trono do palácio. Para voltar, vá até [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#785.src: This is it, we stand at the precipice of change...
Ensemble of Hope#785.dst: É agora: estamos à beira da mudança...
Ensemble of Hope#785.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#786.src: With your help, the resistance can create a better future for Fruma, and put an end to this madness!
Ensemble of Hope#786.dst: Com a sua ajuda, a Resistência pode criar um futuro melhor para Fruma e pôr fim a esta loucura!
Ensemble of Hope#786.speaker: Arnol

Ensemble of Hope#787.src: ...As if it wasn't already enough that I missed that train and had to buy ANOTHER ticket...
Ensemble of Hope#787.dst: ...Como se não bastasse eu ter perdido aquele trem e ter que comprar OUTRA passagem...
Ensemble of Hope#787.speaker: Businessman

Ensemble of Hope#788.src: ...I get home and an insurgency has taken over the damn place??? What is going on???
Ensemble of Hope#788.dst: ...Chego em casa e uma insurgência tomou conta da droga do lugar??? O que está acontecendo???
Ensemble of Hope#788.speaker: Businessman

Ensemble of Hope#789.src: OH, OH, AND JUST AS I THOUGHT IT COULDN'T GET WORSE, LOOK WHO SHOWS UP TO ADD INSULT TO INJURY. YOU.
Ensemble of Hope#789.dst: AH, AH, E BEM QUANDO EU ACHAVA QUE NÃO PODIA PIORAR, OLHA QUEM APARECE PRA JOGAR SAL NA FERIDA. VOCÊ.
Ensemble of Hope#789.speaker: Businessman

Ensemble of Hope#790.src: SO, WHAT, HUH? WHAT'S GOING ON? IS THIS ALL SOME SORT OF... DIVINE PUNISHMENT FOR THE WAY I SPOKE TO YOU BACK OUTSIDE THE SUBWAY??? I'M SORRY, I'M SORRY, OKAY??? PLEASE... MAKE IT END!!!
